producerAndFrequency.configuration: ProtectKeysWithDpapi() calls the Boolean overload with false (DataProtectionBuilderExtensions.cs:301-332). The fallback XmlKeyManager configuration selects DpapiXmlEncryptor on Windows with a user-profile repository and chooses current-user versus local-machine scope using the existing CanProtectToCurrentUserAccount probe (XmlKeyManager.cs:645-705). Explicit repositories/encryptors and other environments may select different paths.
normalProducer: KeyRingBasedDataProtector.Protect gets the current key ring, then uses its DefaultAuthenticatedEncryptor for the payload (KeyRingBasedDataProtector.cs:96-123). This is not DpapiXmlEncryptor.Encrypt for every payload.

KeyRingProvider returns a valid cached ring directly. Its creation/refresh policy considers key resolution, default-key availability, expiration, an existing replacement, and automatic-generation settings before calling IKeyManager.CreateNewKey (KeyRingProvider.cs:83-165, 330-342). A ring refresh is not itself a new-key encryption.

XmlKeyManager.CreateNewKey reaches IInternalXmlKeyManager.CreateNewKey, exports the new descriptor, invokes existing escrow handling, then KeyEncryptor?.EncryptIfNecessary(keyElement) before repository StoreElement and cache invalidation (XmlKeyManager.cs:145-154, 504-555).

EncryptIfNecessary calls the configured IXmlEncryptor once per marked subtree, not once per request (XmlEncryptionExtensions.cs:102-135). KeyManagementOptionsSetup defaults to AuthenticatedEncryptorConfiguration when no configuration has been supplied. Its built-in AuthenticatedEncryptorDescriptor exports one MasterKey.ToMasterKeyElement; SecretExtensions marks that one masterKey element for encryption. This is the ordinary successful built-in descriptor path, not a bound on custom descriptors.
producerAndFrequency.cadence: KeyManagementOptions defaults NewKeyLifetime to 90 days, with a setter minimum of 7 days, a 24-hour ring-refresh period, and a 48-hour propagation window. KeyRingProvider's replacement test includes both refresh period and propagation window; no exact once-per-90-days execution rate is claimed. Empty/no-usable-key initialization and replacement creation can reach persistence; warm payload processing with a valid ring does not execute this XML encryption branch.

semantics.currentOrder: ThrowIfNull precedes scope selection. Current-user identity/name evaluation and the logging call precede XML serialization and are outside the DPAPI try/catch. semantics.exceptionBoundary: Identity/name lookup failures and logger enabled-check/log-call failures can prevent serialization and persistence; they are not caught by DpapiXmlEncryptor's DPAPI catch. No such failure was induced or observed here.
